scientific_integrity: Executable standard-library enumeration, full Hasse DAG and exact signed integer Morse projection embedded in the package.
scientific_limitations: Only the eight-vertex bidirected cube is treated; its integral homology and 2-connectivity are computed by exhaustive acyclic Morse reduction. No higher-dimensional-cube family theorem, sphere-wedge homotopy type, or independent validation is claimed.
title: Integral multipath homology and connectivity of the bidirected three-cube
